title: Grateful Dead Live at Legion Stadium on 1970-12-28

ai_review.summary: Stellar matrix recording delivers crystal‑clear sound of a solid set highlighted by Pigpen’s gems.
ai_review.review: The matrix source captured this 1970 show with exceptional clarity, offering a balanced mix that lets the band shine without overwhelming crowd noise. Reviewers praise the song selection and especially the Pigpen‑led numbers, calling it a gem among the era’s releases.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4–5 stars and consistently praised both the musical performance and the matrix sound quality, indicating an outstanding show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stellar matrix mix praised for clarity and balance; minimal constant screaming from audience makes it a pleasant listen. Described as an upgrade and great sound throughout.

standout_songs: Pigpen‑led numbers (e.g., Turn On Your Love Light)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Cool selection of songs with a smooth flow; reviewers note the set feels like a little gem of a show.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ and vocals singled out as highlights
